name: 메리프
scene: On a quiet grassy electrical research terrace at dawn, standing comfortably with both empty hands relaxed open outside her hips, face toward camera, full head and boots visible.
casual: In a bright fiber-dye studio at midday, leaning over a broad table sorting two fluffy yarn skeins into a shallow tray; complete hands visible separately on the table, head turned gently toward viewer. Soft skylight and jars of colored fiber, no labels.
Cream sleeveless linen vest tied at the waist over opaque blue fitted shorts, open sides secured over an opaque bralette, bare shoulders arms and a narrow midriff gap; tiny orange bead earrings.

At an empty velvet-curtained vintage music revue rehearsal stage at night, taking a balanced small stage step and waving one open hand, other hand relaxed by hip; warm amber spotlight, entire head hands and shoes visible.

Original adult cabaret usher event fashion: opaque cobalt fitted waistcoat with cream satin lapels and secure neckline, high-waisted cream short skirt over opaque dance shorts, small black-gold bow tie, ankle-strap heels. Bare arms shoulders upper legs and a small waist gap. Tiny orange gemstone brooch.

Along a quiet hillside wool-market lane in late afternoon wind, walking with a woven tote supported naturally by one hand and the other open, face turning to the viewer with amused raised eyebrow. Warm stone cottages, linen awnings, empty background.

Opaque mustard square-neck short sundress with broad straps and fitted blue waist sash, lightweight open cream cardigan slipping loosely around elbows, flat sandals, bare shoulders arms and legs; tiny orange bead charm on tote.
